info.description: Personal money management API. Manage wallets, deposits, withdrawals, and transfers. All monetary amounts are in integer cents.
info.title: Money Management API

get.description: Returns debts for the authenticated user. Filterable by wallet_id, direction, and status.

post.description: Records a new debt (someone owes you or you owe someone). Amount in integer cents.
Marks a debt as settled and triggers a wallet deposit or withdrawal via outbox.

get.description: Returns all movements (deposits, withdrawals, transfers in/out) across all wallets for the authenticated user, sorted by most recent first.

post.description: Creates a recurring deposit or withdrawal on a wallet. Amount in integer cents.
Stops an active recurring movement so it will no longer be executed.

Requests a move of money between two wallets and returns immediately with 202. The transfer is carried out asynchronously in two steps and may still fail; poll GET /transfers/{id} for the outcome. A failed transfer moves no money. Amount is in integer cents.

get.description: Reports where a transfer got to. "requested" and "debited" are in flight; "completed", "failed" and "stuck" are final. A failed transfer moved no money. A stuck transfer moved money that could not be returned, and needs intervention.

post.description: Accepts a WAV (PCM 16-bit mono) clip, transcribes it via AWS Transcribe, then interprets and executes the command.
Interprets natural-language text and executes the corresponding action. Used by the typed-input path; the speech path posts audio to /voice/audio instead.

get.description: Returns all wallets belonging to the authenticated user, including current balances.

post.description: Creates a new wallet with an initial balance. All amounts are in integer cents.
Deposits money into an existing wallet. Amount is in integer cents.
Disables a wallet, preventing any further deposits, withdrawals, or transfers. The wallet remains visible in queries.

get.description: Returns all movements (deposits, withdrawals, transfers in/out) for a wallet, ordered by occurrence.
Returns all recurring movements (active and inactive) for a wallet, ordered by created_at descending.

post.description: Withdraws money from an existing wallet. Amount is in integer cents. Fails if balance would go negative.

failure_reason.description: FailureReason is set only for failed and stuck transfers.

message.example: source and destination wallet must differ
